Name: Dyeable Fish Ponds
Author: TimBukTw0
Description:
[size=5][b]About This Mod:[/b][/size]
Are you tired of only SOME fish having cool custom pond colors? Fear no longer! With Dyeable Fish Ponds, you can dye the water in any pond whatever color you like using our [b]FREE[/b] fish-safe water dye. Give those Fish an aesthetically pleasing home! Rainbow trout fans get a special bonus: an optional prismatic dye that cycles through the whole rainbow automatically.

[size=4][b]Overview:[/b][/size]
[size=3]Dyeable Fish Ponds lets you set a custom water color for each fish pond based on the species inside. Simply click the color button on any pond or use a configurable hotkey to open the color picker, choose your color, and hit save. Colors persist through saves are per fish type. Rainbow trout owners get a bonus prismatic mode that cycles through the rainbow cause why not. (You can turn this off in the config).[/size]

[b][size=4]Requirements:[/size][/b]
No additional mods required — just SMAPI.

[b][size=4]MOD COMPATABILITY:[/size][/b]
Dyeable Fish Ponds is compatible with any mod that adds new fish. Modded fish will automatically appear in the color picker alongside vanilla fish, no configuration needed.
